description:
Multi-day rentals are the best value option for a leisurely beach visit - especially during busy Beach Life Festival, Fiesta Hermoa or AVP volleyball weekends. WIth a multi-day ebike, you can get around town, park at any bike rack and get where you need to go with little hassle and all the fun. Request delivery for the ultimate VIP package. Charger, lock and helmet included with each ebike.

Delivery available upon request. Helmet, Lock and Charger included.

##Duration
- 96 Hours
	
##About					
- It's just so much fun! With an electric bike rental, you can experience a new and exciting way to explore all of the beaches from Redondo Beach to Santa Monica while being active and enjoying the outdoors.
- Convenient parking and beach access.  There are 1000s of parking spots at the Redondo Beach Pier with up to 24 hour metered parking.


**Top 5 reasons to rent an e-bike from the Redondo Beach Pier:**
- You can easily hop around from one place to the next without worrying about parking.
- Take in the sun and outdoors without the sweaty grind of pedaling a traditional pedal-power bike.
- Feel like a kid again with the thrill of riding an electric bike.
- Exercise when you want or use the ample power (pedal assist or throttle) to just cruise.
- Convenient beach access without struggling to find a parking spot.

**E-Bike Rental Includes:**
- Single rider e-bike with step-through frame and front basket
- Lock and helmet
- 12 Amp Hour Battery, up to 50 mile range
- 5 level pedal assist
- Comfortable cushioned seat
- E-Bike Orientation:  We provide a complete tutorial on the e-bike so you'll know how to use all of the features and feel comfortable riding. Riders must adhere to the safety guidelines agreed to in the rental agreement.
